correctedState: Real gap, wrong mechanism and wrong subsystem. Nessy has no fallback CHAIN: `workspaceDefaults.fallbackModel` is a single string (validators.ts:135 `z.string()`; default `''` at storage.ts:194; trimmed at storage.ts:273-276), and the runtime does exactly one hop -- `getRetryFallbackModel` (pi-agent.ts:6313-6324) returns that one id for the six codes in FALLBACK_MODEL_RETRY_ERROR_CODES (pi-agent.ts:337-343), `retryWithFallbackModel` `setModel`s to it and re-runs the turn with `fallbackModelRetry: true`, so a second failure has nowhere to go. There is no `fallbackModels` array anywhere in the repo, hence no dedup, no three-entry cap, no `"default"` expansion, no allowlist filtering and no compaction context-window rule. But an array does NOT fail validation: `ConfigDefaultsSchema` is test-only, `loadConfigDefaults()` never zod-parses, and both storage.ts:273-276 and `normalizePiFallbackModelId` coerce any non-string to `''` -- the chain is silently dropped to 'no fallback'. And the file involved is Nessy's own `~/.nessy-agent/config-defaults.json` (rewritten from the bundled asset every launch, with no UI to set the key), not Claude's `settings.json`, for which this fork has no reader (pi-agent.ts:2994).
